name: Ignorance
overview: The Scriptures reveal that ignorance can lead to serious moral and spiritual consequences, as seen in the account of Abraham and Abimelech. Abraham's misrepresentation of Sarah as his sister (Genesis 12:11; 20:2) caused Abimelech to unknowingly take her, prompting God to intervene and warn him in a dream of the grave sin he was about to commit (Genesis 20:3-4). Abimelech's innocence and integrity in this matter highlight how ignorance does not excuse sin, but God's justice and mercy are evident in His protection of the righteous. These passages emphasize the importance of truthfulness and the dangers of ignorance in matters of obedience to God's commands.
